node.title: Re: Align given substring(s) in lines
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As to your example, note [doc://perltidy] does this too, though of course it only works on Perl and does a whole lot more as well.

$ cat example.pl my $string = 'some value'; # these my $int = 12; # are my $float = 1.2; # scalars $ perltidy -b example.pl $ cat example.pl my $string = 'some value'; # these my $int = 12; # are my $float = 1.2; # scalars
